items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So that was a new ... [INTERVIEWER] Well, some day I want you to see these pictures, because you are a mess in that kitchen. [INTERVIEWEE] ... So I said okay, and these were my dear friends -- so I went across the street...

ctx.x: Yeah, we took a bus once. Incidentally, I've been very fortunate to be invited to a few of those parties, and I have some pictures of you when you were chef, where you were making grape leaves in the kitchen -- I have some of these great, some of my very precious pictures of you in the kitchen with a whole chef's uniform on.

Well, that was for Mattie. She asked -- I had cooked every year previous to that, and she called me up. He called me for the party and he says you got to cook, and I said, 'Yeah? What do you want?' and he said, 'Mattie, what do you want Cliff to cook?' -- because I always got a big bang out of chefi ng. So she said how about some stuffed grape leaves, and I said, ah, come on, I'm used to cooking spaghetti and all that, and I had cooked some dinners out there, and I said what's with the grape leaves?

So I said okay, and these were my dear friends -- so I went across the street, and there was a camera man from CBS who lives across the street from me, he's Greek and his wife really cooks. So I say do you know anything about stuffing grape leaves? And she told me what to do, where to buy them, etc.
